notes:
ScreenTale 1.18.2 keeps the Editor working when a video frame fails to load and adds faster cutting on the Timeline.

- Preview, the Timeline and the Inspector now recover on their own from a video frame that fails to load, including while you play or drag the playhead back and forth. The last image stays on screen while ScreenTale tries again, and a message appears only if the problem lasts. A missing or changed file is reported right away.
- Pressing Retry in Preview now reloads the video and shows that it is working.
- Timeline thumbnails, hover previews and waveforms try again without needing you to move the pointer or scroll.
- The Zoom navigator stays in place during playback and scrubbing instead of reporting that the source preview is unavailable. It can be edited again when the playhead stops.
- With a clip selected on the Timeline, press Q or E to split at the playhead and delete the left or right side. Drag a clip's edge to reveal more of its source.
